operations.description: records live nested at Data.Providers[].Records[] (an array within an array; the engine's RecordsAt only descends object keys via a dotted path, and cannot flatten across a dynamic number of provider entries), and each record's data-item fields (e.g. DayAirTmpAvg) are a DYNAMIC set of nested {Value,Qc,Unit} objects (driven by the requested dataItems config) each of which legacy flattens into 3 synthetic sibling fields (<Item>_Value/_Qc/_Unit) per key present -- there is no dotted-path wildcard or per-key dynamic-flatten primitive in computed_fields. Genuine ENGINE_GAP, tracked for a follow-up wave; covers both the daily and hourly legacy streams.
